name: Have Relations With... 3 ~Junko to Nami to Naoyuki to Ore~
original_name: have relations with... 3 ～淳子と奈美と直之と俺～
source:
This game is an interactive sex simulation game, where the commands you choose influences the attitudes of those you meet and causes different situations to occur.

The game spans 14 days, from September 4th to September 17th. The game continues by the selection of commands, having sex and having conversations.

The sex part contains two couples that have sex together: the hero and Junko, plus Nami and Naoyuki.
Depending on your selection, the attitudes of the people you meet will change, and different situations will occur, so try out a number of things.

[description from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE035257.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一款互动性爱模拟游戏。玩家所选指令会影响遇见之人的态度，并引发不同情境。

故事从9月4日持续至9月17日，共14天。玩家通过选择指令、进行性行为与对话推动游戏。

性爱部分由两对情侣共同交媾：主人公与淳子，以及奈美与直之。不同选择会改变人物态度、触发不同发展，请尽情尝试各种行动。

[简介译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE035257.html]DLsite English[/url]]
